info.name: Couchbase Analytics Service REST Allowed CIDRs Search Monitoring API
Get document count for a search index

params.name: indexName
params.description: The name of the Full Text Search index

items.docs: Returns the number of documents that have been indexed by the specified Full Text Search index.
Returns aggregate statistics for the Search service and all indexes on the node.

info.name: Get statistics for a search index

params.name: indexName
params.description: The name of the Full Text Search index

items.docs: Returns detailed statistics for a specific search index including document count, mutation throughput, and query performance metrics.
Returns namespace-level statistics for the Search service that can be consumed by monitoring systems like Prometheus.
